name: Akashi
type: big city; second-level administrative division; port city; core city of Japan; special city of Japan
text: Akashi (明石市, Akashi-shi; Japanese pronunciation: [ä́.kä̀.ɕì, ä̀.kä́.ɕí.ɕì]) is a city in southern Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. As of 1 February 2024, the city had an estimated population of 305,925 in 137,288 households and a population density of 6,200 people per km2. The total area of the city is 49.42 square kilometres (19.08 sq mi).

depictions.name: Akashi
depictions.text: Akashi, Hyōgo Akashi (明石市) is a city in Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was located in the Kakogawa Estuary's southeastern section, within the province of Harima. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited Akashi while traveling in the province.
